request.query: For natural q r real delta, 2 ≤ q^(delta*r) implies delta*r*log q/2 < log (floor(q^(delta*r)))

      "informal_name": "Natural Logarithm Upper Bound: $ \\ln(n) \\leq n^{\\varepsilon}/\\varepsilon $",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → Real.log ↑n ≤ ↑n ^ ε / ε",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ n $ and positive real number $ \\varepsilon $, the natural logarithm of $ n $ satisfies $ \\ln(n) \\leq \\frac{n^{\\varepsilon}}{\\varepsilon} $.",

    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Behrend.le_sqrt_log",
      "informal_name": "Behrend's Inequality: $\\log\\left(\\frac{2}{1 - 2/e}\\right) \\cdot \\frac{69}{50} \\leq \\sqrt{\\log N}$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {N : ℕ}, 4096 ≤ N → Real.log (2 / (1 - 2 / Real.exp 1)) * (69 / 50) ≤ √(Real.log ↑N)",
      "informal_description": "For any real number $ N $ satisfying $ N \\geq 4096 $, the inequality $ \\log\\left(\\frac{2}{1 - \\frac{2}{e}}\\right) \\cdot \\frac{69}{50} \\leq \\sqrt{\\log N} $ holds.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Combinatorics.Additive.AP.Three.Behrend"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Behrend.le_N",
      "informal_name": "Behrend's Exponential Upper Bound Inequality",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {N : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N → (2 * Behrend.dValue N - 1) ^ Behrend.nValue N ≤ N",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ N \\geq 2 $, the inequality $ (2 \\cdot d - 1)^{\\lceil \\sqrt{\\ln N} \\rceil} \\leq N $ holds, where $ d = \\lfloor \\frac{N^{1/\\lceil \\sqrt{\\ln N} \\rceil}}{2} \\rfloor $ is Behrend's d-value and $ \\lceil \\sqrt{\\ln N} \\rceil $ is the ceiling of the square root of the natural logarithm of $ N $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Combinatorics.Additive.AP.Three.Behrend"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Int.self_le_zpow_clog",
      "informal_name": "Integer Logarithm Upper Bound Inequality",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]\n  {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ (r : R), r ≤ ↑b ^ Int.clog b r",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $b > 1$ and element $r$ in a floor semiring $R$, it holds that $r \\leq b^{\\lceil \\log_b \\lceil r \\rceil \\rceil}$ when $r \\geq 1$, and $r \\leq b^{-\\lfloor \\log_b \\lfloor r^{-1} \\rfloor \\rfloor}$ otherwise, where $\\lceil \\cdot \\rceil$ and $\\lfloor \\cdot \\rfloor$ denote ceiling and floor operations respectively.",

    },

      "informal_name": "Natural Base-2 Logarithm is Less Than or Equal to Real Base-2 Logarithm",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n : ℕ), ↑n.log2 ≤ Real.logb 2 ↑n",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ n $, the base-2 logarithm of $ n $ as a natural number (defined as the floor of the real base-2 logarithm of $ n $) is less than or equal to the real base-2 logarithm of $ n $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Base"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.pow_log_le_add_one",
      "informal_name": "$ b^{\\lfloor \\log_b x \\rfloor} \\leq x + 1 $",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (b x : ℕ), b ^ Nat.log b x ≤ x + 1",
      "informal_description": "For any natural numbers $ b $ and $ x $, the inequality $ b^{\\lfloor \\log_b x \\rfloor} \\leq x + 1 $ holds, where $ \\lfloor \\log_b x \\rfloor $ denotes the greatest integer $ e $ such that $ b^e \\leq x $. This accounts for edge cases where $ b \\leq 1 $ or $ x = 0 $, in which the left-hand side evaluates to $ 1 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Log"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.log_le_clog",
      "informal_name": "Nat.log is Less Than or Equal to Nat.clog",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (b n : ℕ), Nat.log b n ≤ Nat.clog b n",
      "informal_description": "For all natural numbers $ b $ and $ n $, the value of $ \\log_b n $ computed by Nat.log is less than or equal to the value computed by Nat.clog, i.e., $ \\log_b n \\leq \\lfloor \\max(0, \\log_b n) \\rfloor $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Log"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Int.lt_zpow_succ_log_self",
      "informal_name": "Integer Logarithm Inequality: $ r < b^{\\log_b r + 1} $",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]\n  {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ (r : R), r < ↑b ^ (Int.log b r + 1)",
      "informal_description": "For any integer base $ b > 1 $ and real number $ r $, the value of $ r $ is strictly less than $ b $ raised to the power of $ \\log_b r + 1 $, where $ \\log_b r $ denotes the integer logarithm function (returning $ \\lfloor \\log_b r \\rfloor $ for $ r \\geq 1 $ and $ -\\lceil \\log_b(1/r) \\rceil $ for $ r < 1 $).",

items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → Real.log ↑n ≤ ↑n ^ ε / ε
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $ and positive real number $ \varepsilon $, the natural logarithm of $ n $ satisfies $ \ln(n) \leq \frac{n^{\varepsilon}}{\varepsilon} $.
For any real number $ N $ satisfying $ N \geq 4096 $, the inequality $ \log\left(\frac{2}{1 - \frac{2}{e}}\right) \cdot \frac{69}{50} \leq \sqrt{\log N} $ holds.

items.type: ∀ {N : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N → (2 * Behrend.dValue N - 1) ^ Behrend.nValue N ≤ N
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ N \geq 2 $, the inequality $ (2 \cdot d - 1)^{\lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil} \leq N $ holds, where $ d = \lfloor \frac{N^{1/\lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil}}{2} \rfloor $ is Behrend's d-value and $ \lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil $ is the ceiling of the square root of the natural logarithm of $ N $.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]
  {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ (r : R), r ≤ ↑b ^ Int.clog b r
items.informal_description: For any natural number $b > 1$ and element $r$ in a floor semiring $R$, it holds that $r \leq b^{\lceil \log_b \lceil r \rceil \rceil}$ when $r \geq 1$, and $r \leq b^{-\lfloor \log_b \lfloor r^{-1} \rfloor \rfloor}$ otherwise, where $\lceil \cdot \rceil$ and $\lfloor \cdot \rfloor$ denote ceiling and floor operations respectively.

items.informal_name: Natural Base-2 Logarithm is Less Than or Equal to Real Base-2 Logarithm
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, the base-2 logarithm of $ n $ as a natural number (defined as the floor of the real base-2 logarithm of $ n $) is less than or equal to the real base-2 logarithm of $ n $.

items.type: ∀ (b x : ℕ), b ^ Nat.log b x ≤ x + 1
items.informal_description: For any natural numbers $ b $ and $ x $, the inequality $ b^{\lfloor \log_b x \rfloor} \leq x + 1 $ holds, where $ \lfloor \log_b x \rfloor $ denotes the greatest integer $ e $ such that $ b^e \leq x $. This accounts for edge cases where $ b \leq 1 $ or $ x = 0 $, in which the left-hand side evaluates to $ 1 $.

items.informal_name: Nat.log is Less Than or Equal to Nat.clog
items.type: ∀ (b n : ℕ), Nat.log b n ≤ Nat.clog b n
items.informal_description: For all natural numbers $ b $ and $ n $, the value of $ \log_b n $ computed by Nat.log is less than or equal to the value computed by Nat.clog, i.e., $ \log_b n \leq \lfloor \max(0, \log_b n) \rfloor $.

items.informal_name: Integer Logarithm Inequality: $ r < b^{\log_b r + 1} $
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]
  {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ (r : R), r < ↑b ^ (Int.log b r + 1)
items.informal_description: For any integer base $ b > 1 $ and real number $ r $, the value of $ r $ is strictly less than $ b $ raised to the power of $ \log_b r + 1 $, where $ \log_b r $ denotes the integer logarithm function (returning $ \lfloor \log_b r \rfloor $ for $ r \geq 1 $ and $ -\lceil \log_b(1/r) \rceil $ for $ r < 1 $).
